description: This file contains functions and types for managing systemd services, including reading, writing, enabling, disabling, and querying systemd units, specifically for user services and legacy units, with integration for environment variables and file handling.

methods.name: resolveSystemdUnitPathForName
methods.description: Constructs the full path to a systemd user service unit file based on environment and service name.

methods.name: resolveSystemdServiceName
methods.description: Determines the systemd service name, considering overrides and profile-based defaults.

methods.name: resolveSystemdUnitPath
methods.description: Gets the full path to the systemd unit file for the current service.

methods.name: resolveSystemdUserUnitPath
methods.description: Alias for resolveSystemdUnitPath, for clarity in user service context.

methods.name: readSystemdServiceExecStart
methods.description: Reads and parses the ExecStart and related environment info from a systemd unit file.

methods.name: buildEnvironmentValueSources
methods.description: Builds a record indicating the source of environment variables (inline or file).

methods.name: expandSystemdSpecifier
methods.description: Replaces specifiers like %h in systemd unit inputs with environment-specific paths.

methods.name: parseEnvironmentFileSpecs
methods.description: Parses environment file specifications, handling quotes and escapes.

methods.name: parseEnvironmentFileLine
methods.description: Parses a line from an environment file into key-value pair.

methods.name: readSystemdEnvironmentFile
methods.description: Reads and parses an environment file into key-value pairs.

methods.name: resolveSystemdEnvironmentFiles
methods.description: Resolves environment variables from specified environment files.

methods.name: parseSystemdShow
methods.description: Parses output from 'systemctl show' into a structured object.

methods.name: execSystemctl
methods.description: Executes the systemctl command with specified arguments.

methods.name: readSystemctlDetail
methods.description: Concatenates stdout and stderr from systemctl command for pattern matching.

methods.name: isSystemdUnitNotEnabled
methods.description: Checks if systemd unit is not enabled based on detail string.

methods.name: isSystemdUserScopeUnavailable
methods.description: Checks if systemd user scope is unavailable based on detail string.

methods.name: isGenericSystemctlIsEnabledFailure
methods.description: Detects generic failures when checking if a service is enabled.

methods.name: isNonFatalSystemdInstallProbeError
methods.description: Determines if an error during systemd install probe is non-fatal.

methods.name: resolveSystemctlDirectUserScopeArgs
methods.description: Returns args for direct systemctl user scope.

methods.name: resolveSystemctlMachineScopeUser
methods.description: Resolves the machine user for systemctl commands based on environment.

methods.name: resolveSystemctlMachineUserScopeArgs
methods.description: Builds args for systemctl machine user scope.

methods.name: shouldFallbackToMachineUserScope
methods.description: Determines if fallback to machine user scope is needed.

methods.name: execSystemctlUser
methods.description: Executes systemctl commands within user or machine scope, with fallback logic.

methods.name: isSystemdUserServiceAvailable
methods.description: Checks if systemd user services are available.

methods.name: assertSystemdAvailable
methods.description: Ensures systemd user services are available, throws if not.

methods.name: writeSystemdUnit
methods.description: Creates or overwrites a systemd unit file, backing up existing one.

methods.name: stageSystemdService
methods.description: Stages a systemd service by writing its unit file.

methods.name: activateSystemdService
methods.description: Enables and restarts a systemd service.

methods.name: installSystemdService
methods.description: Installs and activates a systemd service.

methods.name: uninstallSystemdService
methods.description: Disables and removes a systemd service.

methods.name: runSystemdServiceAction
methods.description: Performs stop or restart actions on a systemd service.

methods.name: stopSystemdService
methods.description: Stops a systemd service.

methods.name: restartSystemdService
methods.description: Restarts a systemd service.

methods.name: isSystemdServiceEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a systemd service is enabled.

methods.name: readSystemdServiceRuntime
methods.description: Reads runtime status of a systemd service.

methods.name: findLegacySystemdUnits
methods.description: Finds legacy systemd units based on known names.

methods.name: uninstallLegacySystemdUnits
methods.description: Removes legacy systemd units and disables them.
